title: LE10 full-face support variant
sentence: Elliptic thick plate with the whole outer face held: the ESRD support variant of NAFEMS LE10.

expected.quantity: σ_yy at D on the upper surface

theory: This $0.6\,\mathrm{m}$ elliptic plate carries $1\,\mathrm{MPa}$ pressure and fixes all displacements on the whole outer face. It implements the ESRD full-face-support variant, whose independently published target is $\sigma_{yy}(D)=-5.25\,\mathrm{MPa}$. The original NAFEMS LE10 fixes vertical displacement only along the outer mid-plane line and has the different −5.38 MPa target. Eight quadratic layers give −5.234 MPa (0.30% from the full-face reference). Source: [ESRD StressCheck Benchmarks Guide, pp. 29–31](https://www.esrd.com/wp-content/uploads/dlm_uploads/Benchmarks-Guide-Standard-NAFEMS-Benchmarks-Linear-Elastic-Tests.pdf).
